tei:div.tei:p: 00000000 phyag chen sngon 'gro'i dngos gzhi dang sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol 'debs rje bcu gsum pas mdzad pa rtag par zhal 'don byed pa gal che/ na mo gu ru bh+ya/ rang rig chos skur ston mdzad bla ma yi// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun cher dbab pas// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro tshogs ji snyed la// mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol// 'gro kun dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'di dag la// nges shes cher mthong dal ba don dang ldan// mi rtag dran pas dam chos myur 'grub cing*// las 'bras yid ches dge bcu'i las 'bad shog /'khor ba'i 'jigs grol gtan bde'i sa 'thob phyir// dkon mchog gsum la rtag par skyabs su mchi// smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog 'byong bar shog /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas yig brgyas sdig sgrib sbyangs// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs maṇ+ḍal cher 'bul cing*// bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs myur thob shog /zhi gnas rtog pa bral ba'i ting 'dzin dang*// lhag mthong ye shes rab tu gsal bar shog /lus sems gegs tshogs rang sar dag gyur nas// khyad par ting 'dzin gegs la byings rmugs dang*// rgod thor la sogs bar chad kun zhi zhing*// sa lam spang rtogs yon tan rab thob shog /rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis lam bgrod nas// 'brel tshad don ldan rten 'brel thabs mkhas kyis// sems can thams cad rdzogs byang chen po yi// bla med mchog gi go 'phang yongs thob shog /ces karma pa'i mtshan 'dzin bcu gsum pa bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'o/// /dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
